no_adcom_quote.quote: An Advisory Committee was not convened to discuss this NDA as there were no review issues for which Advisory Committee advice was needed.

summary: No Advisory Committee meeting was convened for XTORO (finafloxacin otic suspension, NDA206307). The Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Office/Division Director memo each independently state that no AC meeting was held because there were no review issues requiring AC advice. Accordingly, the advisory committee had no influence on this approval.
